winCondition: Heroes win immediately when Thanos's life reaches 0. Thanos wins immediately when the hero life reaches 0, or on his turn if all 6 Infinity Stones are faceup in front of him and/or in his hand and he snaps.

endCondition.description: Either team's life track reaches 0, or Thanos snaps

notes: family: asymmetric-team. 1 vs many; no points. Starting life: hero track at top space, Thanos track set by total player count. 2-player game: hero takes 2 turns per Thanos turn. Rulebook text per UltraBoardGames summary (no official PDF downloaded).
